column1: Training loop (wet): Gallery -> slipstream A -> Chimney -> Chimney bottom -> Sump -> slipstream D -> Dynamo -> slipstream E -> Cathedral -> slipstream F -> Mouth -> Gallery. About 3 minutes; every stream has a beast in it.
Training loop (dry): Cavern -> Toad Pool -> Roost -> Cavern, on foot; safe from everything wet, unsafe from the toad, the salamander, and the caiman; where the Drowned are strongest.

Blood flow: slipstreams carry blood the way they carry divers, so a kill in the Gallery smells in the Chimney 5 s later and in the Sump 11 s later; the Sump is the map's drain (blood pools there and calls the sleeper shark).

Sightlines: Gallery 20 m between columns; Chimney vertical 30 m; dry chambers 15 m; Sump 6-10 m in silt; Cathedral 40 m across (the long-gun room). Alarm: one region; the Drowned enter from the Lantern Cache.
Rockfall: any noise-6+ shot in the Chimney or Cathedral has a 5% chance to drop a stalactite (200 damage) within 8 m of the shooter's target.
